brainlife.desc: Directory holding several generic/network files, e.g. one network per connection set or parcellation.
brainlife.name: generic/networks
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Keeping related networks from one App run together.

**Not for:** Apps expecting a single generic/network input.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 4 (functionally revealing derivative) by default.

**Apps:** output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/generic.networks.json

files.desc: Folder of JSON Graph Format network files.

identifying_risks: Individual connectomes can re-identify a participant across datasets.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level connectomes are functionally revealing derivatives (connectome fingerprints).
sharing_cautions: Share participant-level connectomes only under controlled access.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for group-average or non-human networks.
Tier 4 for a participant's connectome, which can act as a fingerprint.

intended_use: Keeping related networks from one App run together.
not_suitable_for: Apps expecting a single generic/network input.
